newsitem.title: CANADA: New tolling in the cards for NOVA pipeline.
newsitem.headline: New tolling in the cards for NOVA pipeline.

text.p: NOVA Gas Transmission Ltd, faced with the threat of competition in its Alberta turf, is examining several tolling alternatives in efforts to maintain its position as the top mover of natural gas in North America, NGTL president Bruce Simpson said.

NGTL has mounted a major push to convince shippers that the pipeline network's cost structure, size and geographic advantage are the industry's best bet as Canadian gas production grows by 10 to 15 percent over the next few years, Simpson said in an interview.
